name: safe-file-cleanup
description: Find old files in a folder, show what would be cleaned up, and only after approval move them to an archive folder (never delete). Writes an undo script.

folder.description: Folder to clean up (only its top level, subfolders are left alone)

older_than_days.description: Only files not modified for this many days

archive.description: Where old files are moved. A dated subfolder is created for each run.

steps.run: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const home = require("os").homedir(); const dir = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_FOLDER.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, home); const days = Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OLDER_THAN_DAYS); const cutoff = Date.now() - days * 86400000; const files = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).filter(e => e.isFile() && !e.name.startsWith(".")).map(e => { const st = fs.statSync(path.join(dir, e.name)); return { name: e.name, mb: Math.round(st.size / 10485.76) / 100, ageDays: Math.floor((Date.now() - st.mtimeMs) / 86400000), mtime: st.mtimeMs } }).filter(f => f.mtime < cutoff).sort((a, b) => b.mb - a.mb).map(({ mtime, ...f }) => f); const totalMb = Math.round(files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.mb, 0) * 100) / 100; console.log(JSON.stringify({ folder: dir, count: files.length, totalMb, files }))'

node -e 'const s = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const lines = [s.count + " files in " + s.folder + " are older than " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OLDER_THAN_DAYS + " days (" + s.totalMb + " MB):"]; s.files.slice(0, 30).forEach(f => lines.push("• " + f.name + "  " + (f.mb || "<0.01") + " MB, " + f.ageDays + " days old")); if (s.count > 30) lines.push("… and " + (s.count - 30) + " more"); lines.push("They will be MOVED (not deleted) to an archive folder."); console.log(JSON.stringify(lines))'
echo 'Nothing to clean up: no files are older than the limit.'

approval.prompt: Move these old files to the archive folder?

steps.run:
node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const home = require("os").homedir(); const s = JSON.parse(process.env.SCAN); const stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace(/:/g, "-"); const dest = path.join(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_ARCHIVE.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, home), stamp); fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); const q = p => "\x27" + p.replace(/\x27/g, "\x27\\x27\x27") + "\x27"; const undo = ["#!/bin/sh", "# Moves the archived files back to where they came from."]; let moved = 0; for (const f of s.files) { const from = path.join(s.folder, f.name); const to = path.join(dest, f.name); if (!fs.existsSync(from)) continue; try { fs.renameSync(from, to) } catch (e) { if (e.code !== "EXDEV") throw e; fs.copyFileSync(from, to); fs.unlinkSync(from) } undo.push("mv -n " + q(to) + " " + q(from)); moved += 1 } fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dest, "undo.sh"), undo.join("

Changed your mind? Run: sh " + q(path.join(dest, "undo.sh")))'
